_meta.description: Voice descriptions sourced from official documentation

kokoro_grade_legend.overall_grade: Estimated overall quality (A highest, F lowest). Reflects training data quality and quantity.
kokoro_grade_legend.target_quality: A-D: Quality of the reference voice audio and text alignment.
kokoro_grade_legend.training_duration: HH hours > H hours > MM minutes > M minutes — more data generally means better quality.

voices.quality_note: Flagship Kokoro voice. Highest quality grade (A). Warm, intimate tone.
voices.description: Warm, intimate American female voice. The flagship Kokoro voice with the highest overall quality grade (A). Best for emotional narration, intimate dialogue, cozy storytelling, and romantic scenes.

voices.quality_note: Moderate quality (C). Limited training data (MM minutes).
voices.description: Neutral, versatile American female voice. A serviceable all-purpose voice with moderate training data.

voices.quality_note: Above-average quality (C+). Named after a Muse.
voices.description: Expressive American female voice with dramatic resonance. Named after Aoede, the Muse of song in Greek mythology. Decent quality with noticeable expressiveness.

voices.quality_note: Premium quality (A-). Most training data (HH hours) among Kokoro voices. Energetic, fiery delivery.
voices.description: Passionate, energetic American female voice. The most extensively trained Kokoro voice (HH hours of data). Target quality A. Lively, firey delivery — excellent for dramatic narration, energetic dialogue, and character voices.

voices.quality_note: Lower quality (D). Limited training data (MM minutes).
voices.description: Casual, conversational American female voice. Light and approachable but with limited training data.

voices.quality_note: Above-average quality (C+). Named after a Persephone epithet.
voices.description: Clear, articulate American female voice. Balanced tone with decent quality. Named after Kore (Persephone).

voices.quality_note: Good quality (B-). Extensive training (HH hours). Studio-quality recording.
voices.description: Polished, studio-quality American female voice. Extensive training (HH hours) yields a refined, professional sound. Best for audiobooks, professional narration, and high-quality content.

voices.quality_note: Moderate quality (C). Fresh, modern tone.
voices.description: Bright, fresh American female voice with a modern feel. Moderate quality with a youthful energy.

voices.quality_note: Lower quality (D). Limited training data (MM minutes).
voices.description: Calm, flowing American female voice. Steady and soothing but with limited training data.

voices.quality_note: Above-average quality (C+). Warm, friendly delivery.
voices.description: Friendly, approachable American female voice. Warm delivery with decent quality. Good for conversational dialogue.

voices.quality_note: Below-average quality (C-). Very limited training data (1-10 minutes). May sound less natural.
voices.description: Light, airy American female voice. Very limited training data (only 1-10 minutes) — may sound less natural than others. Suitable for short utterances where a delicate quality is desired.

voices.quality_note: Lowest quality grade among all Kokoro voices (F+). Deep timbre but limited effectiveness.
voices.description: Deep American male voice. Lowest overall quality grade (F+) — use sparingly or only for short utterances where a deep male tone is specifically needed.

voices.quality_note: Low quality (D). Limited training data (MM minutes).
voices.description: Resonant, bold American male voice. Quality is limited by training data quantity.

voices.quality_note: Low quality (D). Casual delivery.
voices.description: Casual, relaxed American male voice. An everyman tone with limited training data.

voices.quality_note: Above-average quality (C+). Wolf-themed name suggests grittier tone.
voices.description: Deep, intense American male voice with a slightly gravelly quality. Above-average quality. Best for authoritative characters, villains, or dramatic narration.

voices.quality_note: Low quality (D). Youthful tone.
voices.description: Youthful, friendly American male voice. Approachable but with limited training data.

voices.quality_note: Above-average quality (C+). Most versatile male voice.
voices.description: Warm, authoritative American male voice. The most versatile male Kokoro voice with above-average quality. Best for narration, wise characters, and general dialogue.

voices.quality_note: Moderate quality (C). Dark, smooth tone.
voices.description: Dark, smooth American male voice with a rich quality. Named after the black gemstone. Moderate quality.

voices.quality_note: Above-average quality (C+). Named after Shakespeare's Puck — playful character voice.
voices.description: Playful, mischievous American male voice. Named after Shakespeare's Puck from A Midsummer Night's Dream. Above-average quality. Best for trickster characters, comedic roles, and lively narration.

voices.quality_note: Low quality (D-). Very limited training data (1-10 minutes). Festive character voice.
voices.description: Jolly, deep American male voice — Santa-themed. Very limited training data (only 1-10 minutes). Distinct character voice for festive or lighthearted content.

voices.quality_note: Lower quality (D). British female voice with limited training.
voices.description: Refined British female voice. Limited training data (MM minutes). Best for short British character roles.

voices.quality_note: Best British female voice (B-). Extensive training (HH hours).
voices.description: Warm, polished British female voice. The highest quality British voice with the most training data (HH hours). Best for British narration, period pieces, and premium UK content.

voices.quality_note: Moderate quality (C). British female voice.
voices.description: Elegant, clear British female voice. Moderate quality with a refined UK delivery.

voices.quality_note: Lower quality (D). Soft British female voice.

voices.quality_note: Lower quality (D). British male voice.
voices.description: Deep, formal British male voice. Limited training data. Best for short British character dialogue.

voices.quality_note: Moderate quality (C). Distinguished British male voice.
voices.description: Distinguished, authoritative British male voice. Moderate quality. Good for posh characters, professors, and official narration.

voices.quality_note: Below-average quality (D+). British male with more training than D-grade voices (H hours).
voices.description: Academic, formal British male voice. Slightly more training than other D-grade British voices. Suited for brief formal British content.
